name: WENTEL
recent: 公司近期有多项董事及主要股东权益变动公告，此外，公司于8月27日发布季度业绩，2026年第二季度净利按季增长145.6%。
notable: 公司于2026年8月27日发布截至2026年6月30日止季度的业绩，净利按季增长145.6%。
earnings: 2026年第二季度营收为RM37.23百万，按季增长17.1%，按年增长6.8%；净利为RM6.679百万，按季增长145.6%，按年增长32.9%；净利率从上一季度的8.6%升至17.9%。

recent_en: The company recently had several announcements on changes in directors' and substantial shareholders' interests, including the acquisition of 9 million shares by Independent Non-Executive Director Siow Chin How on 2 October, and share acquisitions by Group CEO Chuah Chong Syn and CFO Yap Yew Wei on 17 September. The company also released its quarterly results on 27 August, with Q2 2026 net profit up 145.6% QoQ.
notable_en: Independent Non-Executive Director Siow Chin How acquired 9,000,000 ordinary shares at approximately RM0.285 per share on 2 October 2026.
Group CEO Chuah Chong Syn and CFO Yap Yew Wei acquired 1,053,000 and 702,000 ordinary shares respectively on 17 September 2026.
The company released its quarterly results for the period ended 30 June 2026 on 27 August 2026, with net profit up 145.6% QoQ.
earnings_en: Q2 2026 revenue was RM37.23 million, up 17.1% QoQ and 6.8% YoY; net income was RM6.679 million, up 145.6% QoQ and 32.9% YoY; net margin rose to 17.9% from 8.6% in the previous quarter.
